name: auto-ziniao-workspace
description: Workspace for Auto Ziniao, a ZClaw-based reusable store-operation flow engine.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/schemas packages/zclaw packages/flow-engine packages/self-heal packages/cli apps/api && pnpm --filter @ww-ai-lab/auto-ziniao-web build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/schemas packages/zclaw packages/flow-engine packages/self-heal packages/cli apps/api apps/web --pretty false
scripts.validate:baseline: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm schemas:export -- --check && pnpm security:scan
